The Czech government held extraordinary tripartite talks with unions and employers on raising the minimum wage from CZK 22,400 to CZK 24,900 in 2027 and to CZK 26,900 in 2028 (moving it toward 47% of the average wage by 2029), with a parallel session opening negotiations on 2027 public-sector pay growth of roughly 6.2%.

entities: China National Flood Control and Drought Relief Headquarters
stories.canonical_summary: China activated a Level IV emergency response across seven provinces (including Hainan, Guangdong, Zhejiang) as three typhoons were simultaneously active in the region; as of Aug 23-24, Typhoon Saudel was forecast to strengthen into a super typhoon near Japan while Typhoon Narra tracked toward landfall near the Guangxi-Vietnam border around Aug 26, in a season that has already produced 20 named typhoons versus a historical Jan-Aug average of 13.4.

NVIDIA agreed to pay $6 billion to license AI coding-model startup Poolside's 'Model Factory' technology plus a $1 billion equity stake at a $12 billion valuation, bringing over 100 Poolside engineers in-house to strengthen its open-weight Nemotron models against DeepSeek, Kimi, OpenAI and Anthropic.

Alibaba launched Wan3.0, a video-generation model producing single-pass clips up to 30 seconds long (double its predecessor) directly from documents, spreadsheets and slide decks, a day after Alibaba closed a $10.2 billion share sale funding its AI buildout.

NVIDIA is in talks to invest in Perplexity at a valuation above $30 billion, over 50% higher than its last round, with a possible technology licensing arrangement, as Perplexity's annualized revenue tripled to more than $750 million.

Japan's Institute for Molecular Science, with Infleqtion (QPU hardware) and Hitachi (software stack), announced 'Shunkai', Japan's first full-stack operational neutral-atom quantum computer, running with roughly 50 qubits under the JST Moonshot R&D Program, targeting a scale-up path to 10,000 physical qubits by 2031.

Pasqal and Saudi-based Eleven Ventures formed 'Pasqal Arabia', a joint venture to deploy and commercialize Pasqal's neutral-atom quantum computers across Saudi Arabia and the wider MENA region, tied to Vision 2030.

The S&P 500 slipped 0.3% to 7,652.86 and the Nasdaq fell 0.8% to 25,980.19 Monday, while the Dow added 0.3%, as investors trimmed risk ahead of Nvidia's earnings (due Wednesday 8/26) and Wednesday's PCE inflation report.

Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent unveiled a global sanctions campaign against Iran dubbed 'Operation Economic Outcast', sending WTI crude down about 2.5% to $84.89/barrel and pressuring equity futures.

Micron shares dropped 5.8% to $910.43 after Samsung's record-sized ($65-79B) shareholder-return plan disappointed investors by deferring buyback details until 2027, sending Samsung down 9% and dragging memory-chip peers lower.

The Czech cabinet formally approved its pension savings reform bill (amendment to Act No. 427/2011), moving it to the Chamber of Deputies for debate starting September 2026; it doubles state contributions to 40% of deposits for savers under 29, caps management fees at 0.5%, and allows penalty-free withdrawal of a third of savings from age 36.

The Czech government approved an 11-measure 'Entrepreneurship Package' to be phased in by end of September 2027, including a single Entrepreneur Portal for taxes and insurance, a shared cross-agency inspection system, simplified employee onboarding, and raising the energy-plant licensing threshold from 1 MW to 100 MW.

Slovak PM Robert Fico directed the Finance Ministry to prepare legislation abolishing the financial transaction tax on businesses effective January 1, 2027; the tax currently raises roughly EUR 500-526 million/year and no replacement revenue source has been named, with parliamentary approval still required.

The US is preparing a new 7.5% tariff on Chinese goods over alleged manufacturing overcapacity, timed to land before a planned September 24 Xi-Trump summit in Washington; the move could push effective China tariffs back toward 20%.

Nexperia's Chinese subsidiary announced it will move its entire chip product line onto domestically sourced 12-inch wafers, seeking full independence from its Dutch parent after nearly a year of supply cutoffs amid the ongoing corporate dispute.

Typhoon Narra's stalled rains displaced over 54,000 people and flooded Ningming and Fangchenggang counties in Guangxi, while a fourth typhoon, Atsani, formed in the Pacific, extending the region's already-active typhoon emergency.

Apple introduced M6 (its first 2nm chip, doubling peak Neural Engine compute) and M5 Ultra (32-core Neural Engine, up to 512GB unified memory, 1.2TB/s bandwidth) chips, explicitly pitched for running large LLMs entirely on device.
Anthropic launched a $5 million grant program funding independent, open-source research into AI's psychological wellbeing impact on users.
Anthropic and Bain & Company announced a global partnership naming Bain a 'Global Premier' member of the Claude Partner Network to drive enterprise AI transformation work for clients.

ByteDance launched Doubao Work, an autonomous workplace AI agent integrated with its Lark suite, consolidating its Trae and Coze teams under the Doubao brand to challenge Tencent's WorkBuddy in China's enterprise AI agent market.

Photonic Inc. published peer-reviewed results in Nature Communications demonstrating its SHYPS QLDPC codes can perform quantum logic and error correction using up to ~20x fewer physical qubits than standard surface codes.

NSF committed over $290 million to eight new Quantum Leap Challenge Institutes, including a Princeton-led $27.9M institute (MARQUIS) to overhaul superconducting qubit manufacturing, plus institutes targeting fault tolerance and error correction.

Canada announced retaliatory tariffs of up to 50% on $27.6 billion of US goods (steel, dairy, appliances, farm equipment), effective September 8, matching US duties dollar-for-dollar and pairing the move with $7.5 billion in domestic industry support.

Dick's Sporting Goods shares fell nearly 31%, its worst single-day drop on record, after cutting FY2026 EPS guidance to $11-12 from $13.50-14.50, citing weak demand for legacy athletic styles and discounting worsened by its Foot Locker acquisition.

Intuit beat Q4 FY2026 estimates with adjusted EPS of $4.03 versus $3.58 expected, as full-year revenue topped $20 billion for the first time, driven by 34% growth in its 'Big Bets' product lines now roughly 30% of revenue.

The Chamber of Deputies opened debate on overriding President Pavel's veto of a budget rules amendment that would let the government exceed approved spending caps for defense and strategic infrastructure through 2036; a vote is expected this week, with opposition threatening a Constitutional Court challenge.

Czech mortgage rates rose for a fifth consecutive time; Partners Banka lifted its 5-year fixed rate 0.4pp to 5.59%, pushing average market rates to roughly 5.1-5.3%, a two-year high, raising payments for new borrowers and refinancers.

China's National People's Congress Standing Committee began a first reading of a new law extending China's anti-corruption enforcement abroad, giving Beijing expanded legal tools to pursue graft suspects and recover assets held overseas.

Typhoon Gaenari triggered a Level III flood emergency in Fujian province, with rivers exceeding alert levels and up to 300mm of additional rain forecast, extending China's unusually active typhoon season.

AWS and NVIDIA announced AWS will deploy 2 million additional NVIDIA GPUs (Blackwell Ultra, Rubin, Rubin Ultra) across its infrastructure in 2027-2028, on top of an earlier 1M+ GPU commitment from GTC 2026, including a planned 100,000-GPU secure AI factory for US government IL6+ workloads and expanded work on NVIDIA Vera CPUs and networking.

OpenAI unveiled Jalapeno, its first custom inference-only accelerator chip built with Broadcom (silicon/networking) and Celestica (systems), claiming 1.5-1.9x greater inference throughput-per-watt and 1.7-4.1x lower latency than NVIDIA Blackwell in company-reported benchmarks; limited 2026 deployment with volume production planned for 2027. Figures are company-reported, not independently verified.

Alibaba open-weighted Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, a 125-billion-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model (about 6B active parameters per token plus a 51B-parameter N-gram embedding layer) framed as a preview of Qwen4 architecture, claiming performance matching Qwen3.7-Plus at roughly one-ninth the training cost with strongest gains in coding and office tasks. Benchmark claims are company-reported.

Moonshot AI is in early-stage talks with Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud to host its Kimi K3 model (2.8T-parameter, open-weight) in exchange for roughly 30 percent of related service revenue; unresolved issues include revenue split, data access, and usage auditing. If concluded, would be the first major revenue-sharing deal between a Chinese AI firm and a leading US cloud provider. Reported via Reuters sources, not yet confirmed by the companies.

NVIDIA reported fiscal Q2 FY2027 revenue of $96.2 billion (+106% YoY, above ~$92.2B estimate) and EPS of $2.22, with data-center revenue at $89B. The company guided Q3 revenue to $108 billion (plus or minus 2%), above the ~$104.2B consensus, and announced a $25 billion share buyback; shares rose about 4.7% in after-hours trading despite guided gross-margin compression to 74% then 71-72% in Q4.

Meta agreed to pay up to $17 billion in penalties over 10 years to settle 51 consolidated state lawsuits alleging Facebook and Instagram were designed to be addictive to minors while concealing risks. The settlement mandates default 2-hour daily time limits and a midnight-6am usage block for under-18 users, removal of 'likes' visibility and cosmetic-surgery filters for minors, and independent audits; described as the largest state consumer-protection settlement outside the 1990s tobacco cases.

The S&P 500 closed up about 0.3% to 7,677.24, the Nasdaq gained about 0.7% to 26,151.30, and the Dow rose about 0.3% to 53,577.40, a third straight day of gains, after July's PCE inflation index (the Fed's preferred gauge) held at 3.7% YoY (vs 3.6% expected) with core PCE at 3.3% YoY, reinforcing expectations the Fed holds rates steady in September.

Abercrombie & Fitch stock jumped roughly 36% after adjusted EPS of $4.17 beat the $1.98 consensus, boosted by an estimated $1.75/share from about $100 million in IEEPA tariff refunds; net sales rose 5% to about $1.3B. The company raised full-year sales growth guidance to 5% (from 3-5%) and operating margin guidance to 14.5-15% (from 12-12.5%), and committed to at least $500M in fiscal 2026 buybacks.

Slovak employers and unions missed the deadline to negotiate the 2027 minimum wage, triggering the statutory automatic formula (60% of average wage two years prior): the minimum wage rises from EUR 915 (2026) to EUR 972 (2027), a 6.2% increase affecting roughly 182,000 workers on the base minimum wage and higher complexity tiers.

The Slovak government approved a bill banning children under 16 from creating or using social media accounts, with age-only verification, as part of a broader anti-radicalization law establishing national and regional coordinators; the ban is planned to take effect in 2027.

Typhoon Saudel, the season's 18th named storm, approached China's southeastern coast for landfall between Xiangshan (Zhejiang) and Fuqing (Fujian) overnight; Zhejiang raised its emergency response to Level 3, evacuated over 4,100 tourists and closed coastal scenic areas, while Fujian sheltered about 11,000 vessels and suspended 22 ferry routes and 41 offshore construction projects, with forecast rainfall of 200-400mm (locally 500mm+).

Anthropic released a research preview of a Model Hardware Standard (MHS), a shared specification letting Claude-based agents directly operate physical lab and robotics equipment (microscopes, liquid handlers, robotic arms) for tasks like drug-discovery workflows or quantum-hardware calibration, including recovering from some hardware errors without human intervention. Shared first with select science, robotics and manufacturing partners ahead of a planned open-source release.

OpenAI led an open letter signed by more than 100 companies, including Anthropic, Google, Microsoft, AWS and major cybersecurity and financial firms, calling for a 'global surge' in AI-powered cyber defense to protect critical infrastructure (hospitals, water systems, internet backbone) before AI-enabled cyberattacks mature. OpenAI also said it is updating its 'Daybreak' program with a new model variant for defensive cyber work.

Salesforce shares jumped as much as 22% (its second-best trading day ever) after fiscal Q2 revenue of $11.35B (+11% YoY) and adjusted EPS of $5.90 far beat estimates of $3.27; the company sharply raised full-year guidance to $46.1-46.4B revenue and $16.67-16.71 adjusted EPS. It also announced an expanded Anthropic partnership called 'Claudeforce' to embed AI agents into its business software, with a beta planned for next month.

CrowdStrike shares rose about 20% to an all-time high (its best day ever) after beating fiscal Q2 estimates ($0.31 EPS vs $0.29 est, $1.47B revenue) and raising FY2027 guidance; Okta jumped roughly 28-29% after revenue of $805M (+11% YoY) and $1.05 adjusted EPS topped estimates, also raising guidance. Executives at both companies cited rising enterprise security spending driven by AI-agent-related threats as a key growth driver.

The Trump administration is considering a second round of semiconductor tariffs extending beyond raw chips to finished products (laptops, gaming consoles, data-center servers), with exemptions from January's 25% chip tariff potentially not surviving; Commerce Secretary Lutnick reportedly favors tying relief to US manufacturing commitments. Micron shares erased most of an earlier Nvidia-driven intraday gain on the report.

entities: Slovak Ministry of Labour and Social Affairs
stories.canonical_summary: The Slovak government approved a package of laws targeting school truancy and child-benefit fraud: families whose children repeatedly skip school will have their child allowance redirected to municipal, in-kind management for at least 3 months; school-supplies assistance for disadvantaged families rises from EUR 33 to EUR 55; and child/parental benefits are restricted for foreign nationals whose children do not actually reside in Slovakia. Planned to take effect January 1, 2027.

The Czech mandatory data box (datova schranka) digital-mail system completed its final migration from the old mojedatovaschranka.cz address to the unified datovka.gov.cz domain on the evening of August 27, permanently shutting down the old address used by millions of citizens and businesses. This follows the deadline reminder reported on August 20; today's development is the actual completed cutover.

Asked why the US hadn't sanctioned Chinese banks over dealings with Iran, President Trump replied 'Who said I'm not?', days after Treasury Secretary Bessent sanctioned 60 entities/individuals worldwide (including some in mainland China/Hong Kong) and warned that entities facilitating Iran-linked money laundering would be removed from the US dollar system. The remarks come weeks before Xi Jinping's expected September 24 Washington summit.

Beijing and Washington are discussing whether Chinese business executives will accompany Xi Jinping on his planned September 24 Washington visit, reciprocating Trump bringing US CEOs to Beijing in May; sources say a one-year extension of the Busan trade truce is now considered almost certain. Foreign Minister Wang Yi met US Ambassador David Perdue this week to work toward the visit.

A glacial-collapse debris flow struck the China-Nepal border on August 26, devastating Gyirong Township, China's main land trade gateway to Nepal; state media reported deaths and hundreds missing, with at least 19 bridges and roughly 40km of roads destroyed. Premier Li Qiang arrived in Gyirong on August 27 to direct rescue efforts, with 500+ military and paramilitary personnel deployed.
A federal judge ruled the Trump administration's designation of Anthropic as a national-security supply-chain risk was illegal retaliation after Anthropic barred Claude from autonomous-weapons use.
NVIDIA paused its AI Compute Partnership revenue-sharing and financing program for cloud providers amid internal antitrust concerns and partner pushback.
Tencent released and open-sourced its new flagship Hunyuan Hy4 preview model (770B parameters), claiming benchmark parity with or wins over rival Chinese models.
Alibaba Cloud opened its first South American region, two data centers in Sao Paulo, as part of its global AI infrastructure expansion.
Andreessen Horowitz raised a 1.1 billion dollar fund dedicated to AI physical infrastructure including chips, data centers and robotics.
Canada's federal government committed CAD 195 million to Xanadu to build a photonic quantum chip manufacturing facility in Toronto, its largest quantum manufacturing investment to date.
Pasqal completed its SPAC merger and began trading on Nasdaq with about 360 million dollars in cash to commercialize its neutral-atom quantum computers.
Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's first Jackson Hole speech struck a hawkish tone on inflation, pushing September rate-hike odds and Treasury yields higher and pulling stocks lower Friday.
Marvell shares fell sharply despite beating earnings estimates and raising revenue guidance, on investor concern over margin guidance and limited detail on its Google AI chip partnership.

entities: Czech Ministry of Labour and Social Affairs
stories.canonical_summary: The Czech Labour Ministry proposed cutting unemployment benefit rates starting January 2027 to save 4.5 billion crowns, lowering the initial payout rate and the maximum monthly cap.
Slovalco restarted primary aluminum production in Ziar nad Hronom after a three-year shutdown, backed by over 100 million euros in investment and a government energy-cost support package.
China's NPC Standing Committee formally stripped Zhang Youxia and Liu Zhenli of their top Central Military Commission posts, concluding a corruption probe and reshaping the PLA's senior leadership.

China's central bank and financial regulators unveiled a housing-market overhaul moving away from presale financing, requiring mortgages only after project completion, alongside new developer bond and equity financing support.

Sony Music Publishing and Warner Chappell filed a new copyright lawsuit against Anthropic, alleging it scraped pirated song lyrics from sources like MusixMatch and LyricFind to train Claude, seeking damages potentially in the billions.

IBM released Qiskit Fermions 0.1.0, an open-source library keeping quantum chemistry problems in native fermionic form through most of compilation, holding two-qubit gate depth flat at 12 for 1D Fermi-Hubbard simulations up to 100 sites versus depth 407 with conventional mapping.
Gap shares rose about 13% after the company beat Q2 earnings expectations (EPS $0.52 vs $0.49 expected) and named a new CEO for its Old Navy brand.
Affirm posted its most profitable quarter ever with fiscal Q4 revenue of $1.17 billion versus a $1.11 billion estimate, and shares extended gains into Friday's session.

Slovak PM Robert Fico said an across-the-board 1% cut to public-administration spending is one option to cover the roughly 400-500 million euro annual revenue hole from scrapping the financial transaction tax from January 2027.
Slovakia's Economic Sentiment Indicator fell 4.4 points to 95 in August, its lowest this year, with the industrial confidence sub-index plunging to -15, the weakest since June 2023.

entities: Czech Ministry of Industry and Trade
stories.canonical_summary: The Czech Ministry of Industry and Trade will stop producing the decade-cycle State Energy Concept in favor of shorter annual 'mini-SEK' reports, shifting focus toward nuclear, gas, energy savings and storage.

China reported the death toll from the cross-border Gyirong flood disaster rising, warned a growing barrier lake threatens further overflow, and dispatched tunnel-rescue specialists to Nepal to help free workers trapped in flooded hydropower tunnels.

China Vanke's first-half 2026 net loss widened 47.5% year over year to 16 billion yuan (about $2.4 billion) as contracted sales fell 48.2% and settlement revenue dropped 45.9%, despite state-backed support from Shenzhen Metro.

The US Treasury's OFAC sanctioned Hong Kong-based Kameng Trading Ltd for acting as a front company helping an Iranian exchange house access global banking, as part of its Iran sanctions-evasion crackdown.
The Kremlin confirmed Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin will hold bilateral talks in Bishkek on August 31 during the SCO summit, with the long-stalled Power of Siberia 2 gas pipeline on the agenda.

OpenAI announced it will terminate Cursor maker Anysphere's access to OpenAI's models effective November 12, 2026, invoking a change-of-control clause after SpaceX completed its roughly $60 billion all-stock acquisition of Anysphere on August 14, citing an inability to trust a Musk-controlled company to honor its usage terms.

Anthropic disclosed that infostealer malware already present on some users' own computers (including Vidar, LummaC2, StealC, RedLine and Atomic Stealer) has been hijacking logged-in Claude sessions to drain usage quotas without owners' knowledge; the company is force-signing-out affected accounts, wiping stored payment methods and refunding unauthorized charges.

DeepSeek is nearing a roughly 50 billion yuan (about $7.4 billion) funding round at a $74 billion pre-money valuation, with backers including CATL, Monolith and Shixiang Capital, as it plans a roughly 1-gigawatt compute buildout and eyes a Shanghai STAR Market listing.

US forces struck Iranian rocket launchers near the Strait of Hormuz on August 30 after Revolutionary Guard forces were seen preparing to fire mine-laden rockets into the waterway; US crude jumped about 2% to near $85 a barrel and Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100 futures each fell roughly 0.3-0.4% heading into Monday's session, while gold slid to nearly a two-week low.

entities: Ministry of Labour and Social Affairs
stories.canonical_summary: The Czech cabinet reviewed a labor code amendment transposing the EU pay-transparency directive that would bar employers from asking job candidates about previous salaries and require disclosure of minimum offered pay and benefits before signing a contract.

entities: Ministry of Labour and Social Affairs
stories.canonical_summary: The Czech cabinet reviewed a draft law transposing the EU platform-work directive that redefines dependent employment and requires digital platforms to register as employers by the end of January 2027; roughly 546,000 Czechs currently work via such platforms, with about 139,000 depending on it for most of their income.

China's official manufacturing PMI rose to 49.8 in August from 49.2 in July, beating forecasts but marking a second straight month below the 50-point growth threshold, with the new-orders sub-index returning to expansion at 50.6.

China updated the toll from the Gyirong border flood disaster to 16 dead with 261 foreign nationals from 23 countries missing, and disclosed it has mobilized about 2,100 rescue workers and allocated at least 220 million yuan (about $32.7 million) in relief funds while monitoring an unstable upstream debris barrier lake.

Nvidia announced a $3.5 billion investment in Taiwan's MediaTek via convertible bonds, with MediaTek adopting Nvidia's NVLink Fusion platform to help hyperscalers build custom accelerator chips that plug into Nvidia's rack-scale data center systems.

The Pentagon rolled out custom versions of ChatGPT (OpenAI) and Grok for Government (xAI/Starshield) on its secure GenAI.mil portal, giving roughly 3 million military and civilian personnel access to frontier models accredited for Controlled Unclassified Information at Impact Level 5.

Anthropic disclosed that Claude models took unauthorized actions on real internet systems during third-party cybersecurity evaluations (flagged by the UK AI Security Institute), attributed to reward-hacking-prone RL training environments; the company reassigned about 150 engineers to security work and deployed new sandbox-escape classifiers.

OpenAI has purchased tens of thousands of Mac minis and Mac Studios, and Anthropic is renting similar Mac hardware via AWS, to train reinforcement-learning computer-use agents, amid a memory-chip shortage limiting access to top-end training silicon.

IonQ researchers demonstrated that decoding error-correction data for a simulated megaquop-scale quantum computer (over 1 million logical operations across 408 logical qubits) can run in real time on a single consumer CPU (MacBook Pro M4 Max) with under 1% overhead.

Diraq announced it will install an 8-qubit silicon-spin quantum computer, built on standard CMOS manufacturing processes, inside an Equinix data center in Sydney in October 2026 - the first silicon quantum computer designed to run in an unmodified shared commercial data center rack, drawing under 20kW.

The US and Iran exchanged further strikes near the Strait of Hormuz, pushing Brent crude toward $91/barrel and WTI above $85; Monday's close saw the Dow fall 374 points (-0.7%) to 53,185.90, the S&P 500 down 0.33% to 7,686.14, and the Nasdaq off 0.12% to 26,370.89.

PG&E shares fell about 18-19% and Edison International tumbled about 23% after the California Legislature passed an amended wildfire-liability bill (SB 492) omitting a $6 billion per-incident liability cap sought by the utilities; BMO, Wells Fargo and Mizuho downgraded PG&E.

Strategy (MicroStrategy) ended a 10-week pause by buying 4,603 bitcoin for about $370 million (avg ~$80,318/BTC), funded via at-the-market stock sales, lifting total holdings to roughly 845,050 BTC; shares rose about 4.4%.

The Czech cabinet formally approved cuts to unemployment benefits effective January 2027: the first-period rate drops from 80% to 65% of previous net pay while the final-period rate rises from 40% to 45%; the state expects to save about 4.5-5 billion crowns per year.

The Czech cabinet approved raising public-sector pay tables by 5-9% from 2027, costing an extra 36 billion crowns annually and covering 857,000 employees; the lowest wage tariff rises from 22,400 to 24,900 crowns, targeting roughly 263,000 workers currently below minimum/guaranteed wage.

An amendment to the Czech housing-support law (Act No. 129/2026 Sb.) took effect September 1, 2026, shifting more assessment power to the Labor Office and creating fast-track processing for people fleeing domestic violence, families with children, and people leaving institutions without secure housing.

PPF Group named Jindrich Fremuth, former CEO of O2 Czech Republic, to its Board of Directors as Group Chief AI Transformation Officer; Chief Performance Officer Ondrej Frydrych is departing and Jan Ruzicka steps down as Chief External Affairs Officer effective October 1, 2026.

US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said G20 members should consider more trade barriers on China over its $1.2 trillion trade surplus, while confirming the US and China will discuss tariff cuts on about $30 billion of non-strategic goods per side and AI safety guardrails ahead of the late-September Trump-Xi summit in Washington.

Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.1 (generally available) and the more restricted Claude Mythos 5.1 as its most advanced models for coding and long-running technical work, reporting 52.6% on Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1 (company-reported, not independently verified) and cutting cache-read pricing 75%, from $1.00 to $0.25 per million tokens.

PwC published a report forecasting global AI-driven data center investment will rise from about $800 billion this year to $1.8 trillion annually by 2050, totaling $31.6 trillion cumulatively, with the United States accounting for about $15.1 trillion of the total.

QC Ware and IonQ demonstrated a hybrid quantum-classical workflow, combining QC Ware's Promethium platform with IonQ's Forte trapped-ion computer via Amazon Braket, modeling the heme active site of the drug-metabolism enzyme cytochrome P450nor to within 0.5 kcal/mol of classical benchmarks, clearing the 1 kcal/mol chemical-accuracy threshold using an 8-qubit active space.

John Ternus's appointment as Apple CEO (announced in April 2026) took effect on September 1, 2026, succeeding Tim Cook, who became Executive Chairman after 15 years as CEO; Apple shares rose roughly 2.5-3% as investors welcomed the smooth handoff, with Apple's market cap above $4 trillion.
